title: Computer-use security, privacy, failure, and performance qualification
objective: Perform adversarial program-wide qualification across the live browser, transfer, exact-window capture, structured UIA, coordinate fallback, model-adapter, and remote-lease paths. Fix every finding at its root and prove bounded resources, secret minimization, deterministic failure invalidation, non-retry mutation semantics, protected-surface denial, and exact tool/profile authority before P18 exit.

include: browser network attacks: DNS rebinding, redirect widening/downgrade/loops, popup/new-window, iframe, worker/service-worker, WebSocket, QUIC/DoH/WebRTC bypass, unsafe schemes, external protocols, browser permissions, and download auto-trigger
browser identity/failure attacks: host/browser crash, navigation/document/node drift, stale/forged node IDs, process restart, cancellation, timeout, duplicate dispatch, and partial transfer

desktop attacks/failures: stale HWND/PID reuse, element replacement, resize/move/DPI drift, multi-monitor, RDP/session transition, lock/logoff, protected/Quntal/security windows, UAC/Windows Hello/LogonUI/secure desktop, and focus/input races

coordinate/input attacks: stale capture, out-of-bounds coordinates, lease replay/expiry, human physical interruption, repeated/double dispatch, unsupported gesture/hotkey attempts, and clipboard/state tampering

remote isolation attacks: provider/principal/device/session/route confusion, compromised-relay redirection, lease widening/replay, revoke/disconnect/reconnect races, remote self-approval/self-grant, and offline queue attempts

transfer/filesystem attacks: path traversal, reserved/device/UNC/ADS paths, reparse/symlink/junction escape, malicious filenames, type confusion, oversized/truncated payloads, changed upload sources, and duplicate writes/submissions

privacy/secret tests proving password/credential/cookie/token/browser-profile/security-surface data does not enter tool results, audit payloads beyond policy-approved metadata, logs, metrics, crash reports, or donor event streams

resource bounds for browser tabs/processes, host/browser memory/CPU/time, pending requests/transfers, DOM nodes/depth/bytes, screenshots dimensions/bytes/rate, event/result sizes, input/capture/remote leases, and cleanup

source scanning/regression tests for arbitrary JS/CDP, unrestricted shell/script, generic socket/proxy, personal profile, raw model-to-input, remote approval, model self-approval, silent elevation, and silent coordinate fallback
real Windows qualification for Windows-specific behavior and deterministic fixtures/integration coverage elsewhere
exclude: new feature or authority widening except root-cause fixes that narrow/correct existing P18 implementation
new provider distribution packaging unrelated to computer-use qualification
waiving or reclassifying failed security tests without a new governed authorization

authority_delta.approval: None; approval/lease weaknesses must be fixed, never waived.

invariants: all mutation retries after dispatch remain disabled
all volatile authority invalidates on the documented identity/session/policy/restart transitions
resource and output bounds are deterministic and test-pinned
security/privacy findings are fixed at root before exit

acceptance.claim: The complete adversarial matrix passes across browser network/identity, desktop identity/protected surfaces, coordinate leases/human interruption, transfers, model adapters, and remote isolation.
Resource-bound tests prove deterministic ceilings and cleanup for processes/tabs/requests/transfers/trees/images/events/results/leases without unbounded growth or orphan authority.
Privacy tests prove secret-bearing browser/desktop/security data does not leak into logs, metrics, crash reports, audit payloads beyond approved metadata, or donor presentation streams.

Source/behavior regressions prove arbitrary JS/CDP, unrestricted shell/script, generic socket/proxy, personal profile, raw model-to-input, remote approval, model self-approval, silent elevation, and silent coordinate fallback remain unreachable.

All findings are root-cause fixed and exact-head Windows/integration CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual excluded-file review, security/privacy review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000086: P18 exit may activate only after the full adversarial qualification closes with no waived blocking finding.

done_when: The entire P18 computer-use stack is adversarially qualified, bounded, privacy-safe, failure-deterministic, and free of unresolved blocking findings.
